Write the potential in Cartesian coordinates.

r² = x² + y² , cosθ = x / r   
V(r,θ) = ½ k r² + 3⁄2 k r² cos²θ  
    = ½ k(x²+y²) + 3⁄2 k x²  
    = (½k+3⁄2k)x² + ½k y²  
    = 2k x² + ½k y².

Thus the motion separates into two independent 1-D harmonic oscillators:

• x–direction: V_x = 2k x² = ½ m ω_x² x²  ⇒  ω_x² = 4k/m  ⇒  ω_x = 2√(k/m)

• y–direction: V_y = ½k y² = ½ m ω_y² y²  ⇒  ω_y² = k/m   ⇒  ω_y = √(k/m)

The energy of a 2-D separable oscillator is  
E = (n_x + ½)ħω_x + (n_y + ½)ħω_y

Plugging the two frequencies:

E = (n_x + ½)ħ·2√(k/m) + (n_y + ½)ħ·√(k/m)  
  = ħ√(k/m) [ 2(n_x + ½) + (n_y + ½) ]  
  = ħ√(k/m) [ 2n_x + 1 + n_y + ½ ]  
  = ħ√(k/m) (2n_x + n_y + 3/2).

Comparing with the given options, this matches choice (D).

Answer: D
